Overview

Kearney is a city in NE with a population of 34,000. Central Nebraska hub with the University of Nebraska at Kearney and the Great Platte River Road Archway. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.4.
